title: Azure: three selected physical variations with one frozen module
policy_input: Actual RGB, robot proprioception and public CAD; no ground-truth object poses or recorded actions.

cases.variation: Source +3 mm X and +3 degrees yaw
Board +2 mm X and +0.5 degrees yaw

scope: Three selected development rehearsals of the earlier Azure module. All twelve pieces start loose; only Azure executes. No full-assembly, current-Cyan/Red or statistical held-out robustness claim.

response_plot.description: A data illustration, not an additional experiment: planar translation differences of measured RGB estimates and generated targets between each actual variation and nominal. Source/board yaw also changed according to the three-case protocol.

gallery.recording: Recorded native states replayed at 2×, about 15 seconds per scene, 960×600. No new physical trial was created for the video.
gallery.media_grading_scope: Each recording executes only Azure. Full12 task success fields in generic media metadata remain false; Azure module physical success is independently reported in the three-case physical review.

combined_grid.description: The same three actual Azure clips plus the measured response data illustration; not an additional trial.
